{{Top|leg}}
A '''temporary environment pouch''' was a piece of emergency survival equipment found aboard [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] space installations. In case of hull breaches, personnel unable to reach [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] could seal themselves inside a pouch to survive for a short period of time. The artificial [[Atmosphere/Legends|environment]] generated by a temporary environment pouch lasted for twelve [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].
